decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to generate a lot of mana quickly using cards like Ruby Medallion, Desperate Ritual, and Pyretic Ritual, in order to cast powerful spells like Glimpse the Impossible and Ral, Monsoon Mage. The deck also includes ways to generate card advantage and dig through the deck with cards like Reckless Impulse and Wish. The goal is to set up a powerful combo turn where you can chain spells together and overwhelm your opponent with a flurry of high-impact plays.

This deck focuses on using mana ramp and card draw to quickly build up resources and storm count, enabling explosive turns with Ral, Monsoon Mage and other spells to deal large amounts of damage to the opponent in a single turn. The deck utilizes rituals, medallions, and other mana acceleration cards to cast multiple spells in a turn, while also using cantrips and Past in Flames to refill the hand and continue the storm combo. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells before they can effectively respond.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage and efficiently dealing with threats. By using a mix of cheap removal spells and powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog, it looks to establish board presence and maintain control throughout the game. The deck also utilizes graveyard interaction with cards like Cling to Dust and Thought Scour to further disrupt the opponent's strategies.

This deck focuses on filling up the graveyard quickly with cycling creatures like Street Wraith and Curator of Mysteries, while controlling the board with counterspells like Force of Negation. Once the graveyard is stocked, the player can cast Living End to bring back all of their creatures while also getting rid of any opposing threats. Cards like Shardless Agent and Ardent Plea help dig through the deck to find the combo pieces needed to execute the Living End strategy efficiently. Overall, the key idea is to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board state from the graveyard.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It includes cards with abilities to amplify damage output and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds a unique restriction to the deck construction, ensuring the synergy between the cards. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, efficient threats while using control elements to protect its board state and disrupt the opponent's strategies.

This deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces necessary to utilize Underworld Breach in order to generate infinite mana and loop through a variety of powerful spells. By utilizing cards like Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Hidden Strings to untap Lotus Field multiple times, along with Wish to fetch key pieces from the sideboard, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a massive flurry of spells and win the game in a single explosive turn. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Sink into Stupor and Consign to Memory to help control the board and protect the combo.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using powerful cards like All Is Dust, Karn, the Great Creator, and The One Ring to disrupt your opponent's strategy. By utilizing the UrzaTron lands to generate a large amount of mana, you can quickly cast your Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and World Breaker to apply pressure on your opponent. Chalice of the Void and Ugin's Labyrinth provide additional disruption against spell-heavy decks, while cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Boseiju, Who Endures offer resilience and protection against removal.

This deck focuses on using creatures with various abilities to create a toolbox of options for different situations. The goal is to efficiently tutor for the right creature at the right time using cards like Chord of Calling and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician. Each creature has a specific role to play in the combo, whether it's generating tokens, sacrificing creatures for value, or draining the opponent's life. The strategy revolves around using these creatures in combination with other cards to generate overwhelming value and create a winning board state.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to efficiently control the game with a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering important spells, removing key threats, and generating card advantage with cards like Murktide Regent and Psychic Frog. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Toxic Deluge and Orcish Bowmasters to close out the game once the opponent's resources are depleted. The mana base is optimized to support the deck's overall control strategy.

This deck focuses on using Eldrazi creatures to control the game and ramp up mana quickly. Cards like World Breaker and Emrakul, the Promised End are used to dominate the board, while cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple help to accelerate mana production. The deck also includes control elements like All Is Dust and Kozilek's Return to deal with opposing threats. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures and carefully manage resources to secure victory.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on controlling the game with hand disruption and removal spells like Fatal Push and Inquisition of Kozilek. The key strategy is to gradually grind down the opponent's resources and eventually overwhelm them with powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Necrodominance. The deck also includes card advantage tools like Castle Locthwain and March of Wretched Sorrow to maintain a steady stream of threats. The goal is to outvalue and outlast the opponent, eventually sealing the win with powerful spells like Soul Spike and Fell the Profane.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm your opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. The deck includes powerful creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, along with support cards like Lightning Bolt and Goblin Bombardment to provide additional damage and control options. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds extra consistency to the deck's mana base. Overall, the goal is to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure to your opponent to secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of aggressive creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes cards that can disrupt the opponent's strategy, such as Thoughtseize, while also providing additional utility with cards like Goblin Bombardment and Thraben Charm. The inclusion of the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring allows for additional mana ramp and flexibility in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain control of the board to secure a swift victory.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, backed up by powerful support cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Goblin Bombardment. The deck also utilizes a mix of land destruction with Blood Moon and creature removal with Lightning Bolt and Chained to the Rocks. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer adds card advantage and pressure, while Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury serves as a big finisher. The deck aims to establish an early board presence and push for a fast victory.

The main focus of this deck is to gain control of the game through various spells and creatures, while disrupting and removing your opponent's threats. By using counterspells like Force of Negation and Counterspell, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Toxic Deluge, you can control the board and prevent your opponent from executing their game plan. Additionally, cards like Archmage's Charm and Cling to Dust provide card advantage and utility. Murktide Regent and Orcish Bowmasters offer strong creatures to close out the game once you have taken control.

This Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a mix of efficient creatures and powerful removal spells. By applying pressure early and disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, the deck can quickly take control of the game. Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an additional layer of consistency and power, while Goblin Bombardment provides a strong finisher. With a strong mana base and diverse threat options, this deck can adapt to various situations and matchups, making it a formidable force in the Modern format.
